# Parameters

<!-- generated by scripts/gen_docs.py from qicklab/core/params.py and the recipe signatures: edit those, then run python scripts/gen_docs.py -->

Every knob a user sets and every key an experiment reads, with units and meaning. This page is generated from the parameter registry `qicklab/core/params.py` (740 entries: 45 device, 58 session, 462 recipe, 175 cfg); defaults come from the code (recipe, group and device signatures). Do not edit it by hand: change the registry or the recipe, then run `python scripts/gen_docs.py` (`tests/test_gen_docs.py` fails while this page is out of date).

Where a value comes from, lowest precedence first: the library recipe default, the session group (`Session(coherence=G.coherence(...))`), the keyword on the step (`R.t1(relax_delay=5000)`). A `None` default is resolved at run time from the selected qubit in the device file or from the session group, as the Notes column says ([precedence](running_a_session.md#precedence)).

Units: `1` dimensionless count or ratio; `a.u.` normalised IQ; `DAC units` gain 0..32767; `flag` a bool; `text` a string or a choice; `index` a channel, port or qubit number; `dict` / `object` a structured value whose parts are listed separately. Times are in us and frequencies in MHz unless the units say otherwise ([timing and units](concepts/timing_and_units.md)).

Contents: [knobs you change every session](#knobs-you-change-every-session), [device file](#device-file), [session](#session), [step recipes](#step-recipes), [developer appendix: the experiment cfg](#developer-appendix-the-experiment-cfg).

## Knobs you change every session

The values most runs touch, and where each is set; the full tables follow.

| Knob | Set it in | Default | Units | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| readout qubit | `Session(qubit_readout=...)` | required | index | qubit whose resonator is read: readout freq, gain, window and data folder (legacy Qubit_Readout) |
| driven qubit | `Session(qubit_pulse=...)` | required | index | qubit that is driven: freq, pi gain, sigma; recipes resolve device values from it (legacy Qubit_Pulse) |
| charge bias | `Session(bias_v=...)` | `0.0` | V | charge-line yoko voltage set at connect (cfg current_voltage) (legacy start_voltage) |
| qubit frequency | `Qubit(freq=...)` in `devices/<NAME>.py` | per device | MHz | qubit centre frequency (cfg f_ge / qubit_freq) |
| pi-pulse gain | `Qubit(gain=...)` in `devices/<NAME>.py` | per device | DAC units | pi-pulse gain (cfg pi_gain; qubit_gain in regime B) |
| pi-pulse sigma | `Qubit(sigma=...)` in `devices/<NAME>.py` | per device | us | Gaussian sigma of the qubit pulses (envelope 4 sigma) |
| readout frequency | `Readout(freq=...)` in `devices/<NAME>.py` | per device | MHz | readout resonator frequency (cfg pulse_freq) |
| readout gain | `Readout(gain=...)` in `devices/<NAME>.py` | per device | DAC units | readout tone gain (cfg pulse_gain), 0..32767 |
| spectroscopy gain | `Session(spec=G.spec(gain=...))` | `None` | DAC units | drive gain the spectroscopy steps play (None: Qubit.spec_gain, else 800) |
| spectroscopy pulse length | `Session(spec=G.spec(qubit_length=...))` | `50` | us | length of the const drive pulse (gauss=False) |
| spectroscopy span | `Session(spec=G.spec(spec_span=...))` | `10` | MHz | half-width: the two-tone sweep is qubit freq +- spec_span (cfg SpecSpan; build_context derives start / step from it) |
| spectroscopy averages | `Session(spec=G.spec(reps=...))` | `20` | shots | hardware averages per frequency point |
| coherence relax delay | `Session(coherence=G.coherence(relax_delay=...))` | `3000` | us | wait after each shot before the next |
| T1 wait step | `Session(coherence=G.coherence(t1_step=...))` | `5` | us | T1 wait step (legacy T1_step) |
| coherence repetitions | `Session(coherence=G.coherence(repetitions=...))` | `1` | 1 | back-to-back runs, each its own files (also the loop count of trans_qubit_spec and charge_dispersion_ramsey) |
| echo total time | `Session(echo=G.echo(t2_max_us=...))` | `20` | us | total echo time of the last point (legacy T2_max_us) |
| single shots | `Session(single_shot=G.single_shot(shots=...))` | `1000` | shots | single shots per prepared state (cfg shots; programs set reps) (legacy Shots) |
| single-shot readout window | `Session(single_shot=G.single_shot(readout_time=...))` | `None` | us | regime-B ADC integration window (cfg readout_length) (None: the readout qubit's ss_window; legacy Readout_Time) |
| single-shot ADC offset | `Session(single_shot=G.single_shot(adc_offset=...))` | `None` | us | regime-B tone-start-to-ADC-trigger delay (cfg adc_trig_offset) (None: the readout qubit's ss_window; legacy ADC_Offset) |
| Rabi gain range | `R.amplitude_rabi(max_gain=...)` | `10000` | DAC units | last gain of the sweep from 0 |
| parity splitting | `R.modified_ramsey(df=...)` | `None` | MHz | parity branch splitting; tau = tau_harmonic_k / (2 df) (None: Qubit.parity.df_mhz (raises without it)) |
| Ramsey tau harmonic | `R.modified_ramsey(tau_harmonic_k=...)` | `1` | 1 | odd harmonic k of tau = k / (2 df) |
| undriven single-shot passes | `R.undriven_single_shot(repeat=...)` | `1` | 1 | whole acquisitions back to back, each its own files (legacy Repeat) |

## Device file

`devices/<NAME>.py` builds one frozen `Device` (`qicklab.core.device`); values measured on the chip live here, one `Qubit` per qubit. Guide: [adding a device](adding_a_device.md).

### Device

| Field | Default | Units | Meaning | Notes | Read by |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | required | text | chip name; recorded in every saved file's provenance |  | `connect`, `io.start_session`, `record_calibration` |
| `cooldown` | required | text | cooldown date or label of this device file |  | `io.start_session`, `record_calibration` |
| `data_root` | required | text | data root; qubit q saves under \<data_root>/Q{q}// | byte-identical to the legacy QubitFolders | `Device.folder`, `Device.legacy_parameters` |
| `qubits` | required | object | {1: Qubit, ..., N: Qubit}, stored read-only | keys must be 1..N | `Device.legacy_parameters`, `Device.validate`, `Session` |
| `setup` | required | object | instrument endpoints and board overrides (a Setup) |  | `connect` |
| `cavity_min` | `True` | flag | resonator shows as a transmission dip (True) or a peak |  | `build_context`, `connect`, `run_transmission_sweep` |
| `readout_window` | `ReadoutWindow(length_us=15, adc_offset_us=0.3)` | object | regime-A readout window (a ReadoutWindow) | per-qubit Readout.window overrides it | `Device.window`, `connect` |
| `ss_window` | `ReadoutWindow(length_us=15, adc_offset_us=0.3)` | object | regime-B (single-shot) readout window (a ReadoutWindow) | per-qubit Readout.ss_window overrides it | `Device.window`, `Session.groups` |

### Qubit

| Field | Default | Units | Meaning | Notes | Read by |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `freq` | required | MHz | qubit centre frequency (cfg f_ge / qubit_freq) |  | `Device.legacy_parameters`, `Device.validate`, `recipes.amplitude_rabi` |
| `gain` | required | DAC units | pi-pulse gain (cfg pi_gain; qubit_gain in regime B) |  | `Device.legacy_parameters`, `Device.validate` |
| `sigma` | required | us | Gaussian sigma of the qubit pulses (envelope 4 sigma) |  | `Device.legacy_parameters`, `Device.validate` |
| `readout` | required | object | this qubit's readout resonator (a Readout) |  | `Device.legacy_parameters`, `Device.window` |
| `pi2_gain` | `None` | DAC units | pi/2-pulse gain (cfg pi2_gain) | None: gain // 2 | `Device.validate`, `Qubit.effective_pi2_gain` |
| `flattop_length` | `None` | us | flat segment of a flat-top pulse (cfg flattop_length) | None: plain Gaussian | `Device.legacy_parameters`, `Device.validate` |
| `spec_gain` | `None` | DAC units | spectroscopy drive gain the spec steps play | fills the spec group's gain when that is None | `Device.validate`, `groups.resolve` |
| `bias_v` | `None` | V | preferred charge-line bias of this qubit | documentation field: no code reads it yet (Session.bias_v sets the bias) |  |
| `t1_us` | `None` | us | last measured T1 | documentation field: no code reads it yet |  |
| `parity` | `None` | object | charge-parity calibration (a ParityParams) or None | the parity steps resolve df / f_upper / cd_\* from it | `Device.validate`, `recipes` |
| `notes` | `''` | text | free-text notes on this qubit | documentation field: no code reads it |  |

## Session

`Session(device, qubit_readout, qubit_pulse, ...)` (`qicklab.core.session`) holds what one session measures and the shared groups ([running a session](running_a_session.md#session-fields)).

| Argument | Default | Units | Meaning | Notes | Read by |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `device` | required | object | the Device (devices/\<NAME>.py) this session measures |  | `Session.qubit`, `connect` |
| `qubit_readout` | required | index | qubit whose resonator is read: readout freq, gain, window and data folder | legacy Qubit_Readout | `Session.groups`, `connect` |
| `qubit_pulse` | required | index | qubit that is driven: freq, pi gain, sigma; recipes resolve device values from it | legacy Qubit_Pulse | `Session.qubit`, `connect` |
| `bias_v` | `0.0` | V | charge-line yoko voltage set at connect (cfg current_voltage) | legacy start_voltage | `build_context`, `connect` |
| `yoko_fixed` | `False` | flag | hold the bias: charge_sweep repeats the spectroscopy over time |  | `connect`, `run_charge_sweep` |
| `interactive_plots` | `False` | flag | show plots in windows | no effect yet (warns): importing qicklab.analysis selects the Agg backend | `connect` |

Shared groups: `Session(<group>=G.<function>(...))` (`qicklab.runs.groups`); a group left out is the library `G.<function>()` shown here. Every step that names the group reads it ([shared groups](running_a_session.md#shared-groups)).

### G.transmission

`Session(transmission=...)`. Read by `build_context`, `run_charge_transmission_sweep`, `run_transmission_fit`, `run_transmission_sweep`.

| Keyword | Default | Units | Meaning | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `reps` | `20` | shots | hardware averages per frequency point |  |
| `rounds` | `20` | 1 | software repeats of each point's program |  |
| `num_points` | `201` | points | frequency points of the resonator sweep (cfg TransNumPoints) |  |
| `span` | `5` | MHz | half-width: the sweep is pulse_freq +- span (cfg TransSpan) |  |

### G.spec

`Session(spec=...)`. Read by `build_context`, `run_charge_dispersion_quasicw`, `run_charge_sweep`, `run_spec_gain_length_sweep`, `run_trans_qubit_spec`, `run_two_tone_charge_dispersion_quasicw`, `run_two_tone_spec`.

|---|---|---|---|---|
| `qubit_gain` | `1000` | DAC units | drive gain of the regime-A base config (cfg qubit_gain): constant_two_tone and the Gauss=False charge steps | not the gain two_tone_spec plays (that is `gain`) |
| `spec_span` | `10` | MHz | half-width: the two-tone sweep is qubit freq +- spec_span | cfg SpecSpan; build_context derives start / step from it |
| `spec_num_points` | `201` | points | frequency points of the two-tone sweep | cfg SpecNumPoints / expts |
| `qubit_length` | `50` | us | length of the const drive pulse (gauss=False) |  |
| `reps` | `20` | shots | hardware averages per frequency point |  |
| `rounds` | `10` | 1 | software repeats of the program |  |
| `gauss` | `False` | flag | play a Gaussian of `sigma` instead of a const pulse | cfg Gauss |
| `sigma` | `2` | us | Gaussian sigma of the spec drive (gauss=True) |  |
| `gain` | `None` | DAC units | drive gain the spectroscopy steps play | None: Qubit.spec_gain, else 800 |
| `relax_delay` | `2500` | us | wait after each shot before the next |  |
| `display` | `True` | flag | show the spectroscopy fit plot |  |
| `min_sep_mhz` | `0.2` | MHz | smallest separation accepted as a parity doublet | legacy min_sep_MHz |
| `fit_window_mhz` | `0.5` | MHz | Lorentzian fit window around each peak |  |
| `prominent_ratio` | `0.1` | 1 | second-peak height threshold, fraction of the first |  |
| `sweep_lengths` | `(10, 20, 30, ..., 100)` (10 values) | us | drive lengths of the spec_gain_length_sweep grid |  |
| `sweep_gains` | `(200, 300, 400, ..., 5000)` (49 values) | DAC units | drive gains of the spec_gain_length_sweep grid |  |

## Step recipes

One keyword-only function per step (`qicklab.runs.recipes as R`); a misspelt keyword raises TypeError. The step pages ([experiments](experiments/README.md)) repeat each table next to the physics.

Each step's line names the session groups it reads by name: its own group slots, the groups its run function reads, the groups its `None` defaults fall back to and, for a regime-B step, the `single_shot` group its config is rebuilt from. Every regime-A step also runs on the base config built from the `transmission`, `spec`, `charge` and `tones` groups ([regime A](concepts/config_regimes.md#regime-a-what-is-in-the-config)); the regime letter links to what its config holds.

### R.constant_tone

Recipe: `R.constant_tone(...)` (`qicklab.runs.recipes`, `help(R.constant_tone)`): regime [A](concepts/config_regimes.md#regime-a-what-is-in-the-config), calls `run_constant_tone`, session groups none ([shared groups](running_a_session.md#shared-groups)). Page: [cw_tones.md](experiments/cw_tones.md).

| Keyword | Default | Units | Meaning | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `hold_s` | `None` | s | keep the tones on this long (None: until Enter) |  |

### R.constant_two_tone

Recipe: `R.constant_two_tone(...)` (`qicklab.runs.recipes`, `help(R.constant_two_tone)`): regime [A](concepts/config_regimes.md#regime-a-what-is-in-the-config), calls `run_constant_two_tone`, session groups `tones` ([shared groups](running_a_session.md#shared-groups)). Recipe: `R.modified_ramsey(...)` (`qicklab.runs.recipes`, `help(R.modified_ramsey)`): regime [A](concepts/config_regimes.md#regime-a-what-is-in-the-config), calls `run_modified_ramsey`, session groups none ([shared groups](running_a_session.md#shared-groups)). | `average_n_shots` | `50` | shots | bin size of the legacy hard-threshold plot only | keep well below one dwell |

| `control_tau_offset_frac` | `None` | 1 | tau_offset control: fractional tau change | None: the predicted null next to the programmed tau |
| `control_detuning_mhz` | `None` | MHz | drive_detuned control: drive detuning | None: +df |
| `tau_harmonic_k` | `1` | 1 | odd harmonic k of tau = k / (2 df) |  |
| `use_pi_pulse` | `False` | flag | add an echo pi pulse in the middle of the Ramsey |  |
| `flip_final_pi2` | `False` | flag | close with a +180 deg pi/2 (inverts the mapping) |  |
| `symmetric_ramsey` | `True` | flag | drive at f_ge - df/2, midway between the branches | needs the upper branch f_ge |
| `max_drive_bandwidth_ratio` | `1.4` | 1 | cap on branch detuning / pi/2 Rabi rate |  |
| `use_active_reset` | `True` | flag | measurement-based reset before each Ramsey |  |
| `reset_cycles` | `1` | 1 | measure -> conditional pi rounds per reset |  |
| `reset_ground_below_threshold` | `True` | flag | ground state lies below the I threshold | from the separator calibration |
| `reset_readout_relax_delay` | `5.0` | us | wait after each reset readout (>= \~6/kappa) |  |
| `reset_read_latency_us` | `None` | us | settle between reset readout and feedback pulse | None: the program's 0.5 us floor; can raise it, never lower it |

| `readout_threshold` | `None` | a.u. | single-shot I threshold of the reset decision (normalised I) | None: from the separator; core.active_reset scales it by the readout window |
| `ss_calib_shots` | `1000` | shots | shots of the SingleShot separator calibration |  |
| `ss_recalib_every_n_cycles` | `10` | 1 | cycles between separator recalibrations |  |
| `expected_parity_dwell_ms` | `2.5` | ms | expected parity dwell time; sets the analysis time scales |  |
| `drift_window_ms` | `200.0` | ms | window of the drift tracking in the analysis |  |
| `hmm_symmetric` | `True` | flag | fit one switching rate for both directions |  |
| `hmm_bootstrap_samples` | `0` | 1 | bootstrap resamples for the HMM rate error (0: none) |  |
| `hmm_fit_mapping` | `True` | flag | fit the mapping probabilities with the rate |  |

| `mapping_probabilities_calibrated` | `None` | flag | the mapping comes from a calibration | None: Qubit.parity.calibrated, else False |
| `hmm_min_emission_snr` | `None` | 1 | emission SNR below which the HMM rate is flagged | None: 0.7 |
| `hmm_kwargs` | `None` | dict | extra fit_two_state_hmm keywords |  |

## Developer appendix: the experiment cfg

The flat `cfg` dict the experiment classes and their QICK programs read. Users do not set these keys directly: the config builders and the run functions fill them from the device, the session groups and the recipe. `read_by` comes from the regression golden's recording dict (`tests/regression/golden_cstq03.json`, per class `cfg_access`, both boards); `tests/test_params_registry.py` checks it. A scope `cfg:<variant>` is the same key with a second meaning for the classes it names (`qubit_gain` is the spectroscopy gain in `cfg` but the pi gain in `cfg:single_shot`).

### Saved provenance keys no class reads

In every saved `.json` / `.h5` cfg, set by the run functions or the config builders (`qicklab.core.params.RECORD_ONLY_CFG`); Read by names those functions.

| Key | Units | Meaning | Layer | Read by | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `acq_time` | text | local ISO wall-clock time of this slice | runs | `_record_hold` |  |
| `cavity_min` | flag | resonator shows as a transmission dip (True) or a peak | core | `build_context` | Device.cavity_min; the transmission runs read ctx.cavity_min |
| `f_ges` | MHz | regime B: frequencies of the qubits in qubit_pulse, one per qubit | core | `_run_single_shot_at_gain`, `_sync_cfg_to_selected_qubit`, `rebuild_singleshot_config` | the programs play f_ge (the first entry) |
| `FF_Qubits` | dict | fast-flux line map {qubit: {channel, delay_time}} of the board | core | `build_context`, `rebuild_singleshot_config` | carried for the saved record; no program of this package plays fast flux |
| `interleave_cycle` | 1 | cycle of the interleaved run (0-based) | runs | `run_interleaved_coherence` |  |
| `interleave_cycles_total` | 1 | cycles of the interleaved run | runs | `run_interleaved_coherence` |  |
| `interleave_run_id` | text | timestamp that ties the files of one interleaved run | runs | `run_interleaved_coherence` |  |
| `interleave_step` | text | step of the interleaved cycle that saved this file | runs | `run_interleaved_coherence` |  |
| `modified_ramsey_timing` | dict | modelled per-rep schedule of the Modified Ramsey program (experiments.modified_ramsey.modified_ramsey_timing) | runs | `run_modified_ramsey`, `run_modified_ramsey_control` | excludes initialize(), tProc latency and transfer |
| `modulation_block_t` | 1 | stage 3: Welch t of the on-block vs off-block mean scores | runs | `run_zero_span_parity` | zero-span validation provenance; set only when that stage runs |
| `modulation_correlation` | 1 | stage 3: peak normalised cross-correlation of the state score with the drive modulation | runs | `run_zero_span_parity` | zero-span validation provenance; set only when that stage runs |
| `modulation_gate_passed` | flag | stage 3: the modulation gate passed | runs | `run_zero_span_parity` | zero-span validation provenance; set only when that stage runs |
| `modulation_snr` | 1 | stage 3: \|level on - level off\| over the pooled score spread | runs | `run_zero_span_parity` | zero-span validation provenance; set only when that stage runs |
| `mr_parent_cycle_idx` | 1 | cycle of the measurement this control belongs to | runs | `run_modified_ramsey` | set on the control runs only |
| `mr_parent_record` | text | the .h5 of the measurement this control belongs to | runs | `run_modified_ramsey` | set on the control runs only |
| `mr_tau_harmonic_k` | 1 | odd harmonic k of the Ramsey wait tau = k / (2 df) | runs | `build_modified_ramsey_cfg` | the recipe's tau_harmonic_k; the class reads ramsey_tau_us |

### Classes no regression label builds

The golden has no `cfg_access` for these (`qicklab.core.params.UNREACHED_CLASSES`). Where they appear in a Read by column above, the entry comes from the code (the literal cfg keys of the class and its program, `core.readout.cover_readout_window` and qick's AveragerProgram), not from the golden.

| Class | File | Program | Why no label builds it |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AmplitudeRabiFF_N` | `qicklab/experiments/rabi.py` | `AmplitudeRabiPointProg` | flat-top Rabi: run_amplitude_rabi with a flat-top qubit pulse; no label has one |
| `ChargeDispersion` | `qicklab/experiments/charge_dispersion.py` | `ChargeDispersionProgram` | run_charge_dispersion_ramsey: RunChargeDispersionRamsey raises KeyError 'df' before the class is built |
